verdict.rationale: ROS 2 is an open-source robotics middleware framework that runs on the user's own machines. It has no vendor-hosted storage, so selecting a storage region or data-residency location is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence covers only local capabilities such as pub/sub, QoS, DDS-Security and local rosbag recording, and none of it shows a hosted storage service with region choice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
